class: Discovery starved by a small board universe, low per-board caps, manual-only scans, and hidden failures and near misses
fix: SmartRecruiters (paginated q-search, server country filter, detail text) and Workable (one widget call, telecommuting remote flag) readers plus Lever EU-host fallback, wired through dispatch and history URLs; Workday 100->200 results and 40->100 details, iCIMS 15->50 details; one retry on transient failures everywhere (http_get/http_post); scripts/verify_boards.py grows the owner's list only from boards whose API and page agree (58 candidates shipped, live run is the owner's one command); per-board state rows plus failed-board counts and scripts/scheduled_scan.py; STORE_FLOOR 30 keeps near misses retrievable (get_near_misses) and the feed gains company filter plus paging. Jobvite skipped (usable API needs employer keys); title expansion deferred (needs scoring-semantics review).
prevention: New boards arrive as verified-address readers with mocked-shape tests; caps and retries are constants with tests; a failed board records itself instead of vanishing.
root_cause: Five ATS readers over ~124 boards, Workday/iCIMS detail caps discarding most matches, any single timeout zeroing a whole employer, scans only on click, failures logged and forgotten, and everything under threshold dropped instead of shown as near misses.
symptom: The owner saw only a few jobs: 356 stored, almost all Greenhouse, iCIMS zero, Workday 48, and no way to fetch more or see what the scan discarded.
why_tests_missed: Reader tests covered the five old boards; nothing counted caps, retried failures, recorded per-board outcomes, or asked what the scan threw away.
